records.evidence_span: Simvastatin is a cholesterol-lowering medication. CONTRAINDICATIONS: Concomitant administration of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (e.g., itraconazole, ketoconazole, posaconazole, voriconazole, HIV protease inhibitors, boceprevir, telaprevir, erythromycin, clarithromycin, telithromycin) is contraindicated due to increased risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis.
